$ fastexec help

Commands: setup, doctor, lsp, mcp, exec, get, put, sql, job, ping, stats, monitor, tray, handoff, graph, config, daemon, token, version, hello
--- stderr

$ fastexec exec
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec exec [host] <command>
--- stderr


$ fastexec get
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec get <remote_path> [local_path] [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec put local.txt
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec put <local_path> <remote_path> [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec sql
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec sql "<query>" [session_or_db] [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec stats --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
usage: fastexec stats [--today|-t] [--errors|-e] [--tools] [--reset|--clear] [<period>]
  <period>  1h, 24h, 7d ... (hours or days; bare 'today' and 'week' also work)
  Shows telemetry & audit for the period, plus a savings summary.
  --errors   only error records      --tools   only the per-tool breakdown
  --reset    delete the telemetry database
--- stderr

$ fastexec config example

--- stdout
{
  "default_host": "server",
  "hosts": {
    "server": { "addr": "192.0.2.10:9142", "cwd": "/home/user/workspace", "aliases": ["srv"] },
    "router": { "addr": "192.0.2.1" },
    "devbox": { "ssh": "devbox", "hidden": true }
  },
  "telemetry": true
}
--- stderr


$ fastexec config bogus
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec config [show|example|init|set]
  show     effective configuration: file, hosts, default host, data folders, telemetry (default)
  example  print a sample config.json
  init     write the sample to the config file if it does not exist yet
  set <key> <value>
           write one setting into the config file, leaving the rest untouched
           keys: dotnet_sdk (folder of a .NET SDK for the C# server; "-" clears it)
--- stderr


$ fastexec hello a b
exit: 0
--- stdout
hello from an extension: [a b]
--- stderr
